params.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$s=@'
set -eu
cd /mnt/c/HeavenServices/worker-fabric
echo BASE_STATE
docker compose ps --format json
echo BASE_HEALTH
for w in worker01 worker02 worker03 worker04; do
  c="heaven-worker-$(echo "$w" | sed 's/worker//')"
  docker compose exec -T "$w" sh -lc 'test "$(hostname)" != "" && node --version >/dev/null && python3 --version >/dev/null && git --version >/dev/null'
  echo "$w OK"
done
echo ISOLATION
docker compose exec -T worker01 sh -lc 'printf worker01 > /workspace/isolation-proof'
if docker compose exec -T worker02 sh -lc 'test -e /workspace/isolation-proof'; then
  echo ISOLATION_FAILED
  exit 20
else
  echo ISOLATION_OK
fi
echo SHARED
docker compose exec -T worker03 sh -lc 'printf SHARED_OK > /shared/shared-proof'
docker compose exec -T worker04 sh -lc 'test "$(cat /shared/shared-proof)" = "SHARED_OK"'
echo SHARED_OK
echo LIMITS
docker inspect heaven-worker-01 --format 'base cpus={{.HostConfig.NanoCpus}} memory={{.HostConfig.Memory}} pids={{.HostConfig.PidsLimit}}'
docker inspect heaven-worker-05 --format 'burst cpus={{.HostConfig.NanoCpus}} memory={{.HostConfig.Memory}} pids={{.HostConfig.PidsLimit}} status={{.State.Status}}'
echo MOUNTS
docker inspect heaven-worker-01 --format '{{range .Mounts}}{{.Type}} {{.Destination}} {{.RW}};{{end}}'
echo PORTS
ports="$(docker port heaven-worker-01 || true)"
if [ -z "$ports" ]; then echo NO_PUBLISHED_PORTS; else echo "$ports"; exit 21; fi
echo RESOURCES
docker stats --no-stream --format '{{.Name}}|{{.CPUPerc}}|{{.MemUsage}}|{{.PIDs}}' heaven-worker-01 heaven-worker-02 heaven-worker-03 heaven-worker-04
echo MEMORY
free -h
'@
$b64=[Convert]::ToBase64String([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($s))
& wsl.exe -d Ubuntu -- bash -lc "echo $b64 | base64 -d | bash"
exit $LASTEXITCODE
